sights.n: Ryukyu Glass Village, Itoman (琉球ガラス村)
sights.w: Okinawa's largest handmade-glass factory, with galleries and shops of colourful Ryukyu glass and first-come glass-blowing classes at its Workshop Think Think. Rurubu lists it as a southern-Okinawa craft stop and Stripes Okinawa has covered its hands-on workshop.
